editorial:
Ever wonder what it was like to be a trailblazing woman in the 1920s? You will love meeting Pat Clancy, a girl with big dreams and a camera who just wants to prove she can handle the news business. When her dad hires her at his paper, it sparks a huge fight with Scoop Morgan, the grumpy top cameraman who thinks women don't belong in the field. The vibe is super energetic and playful, turning into a funny competition as Pat and Scoop race to get the best stories. It feels like a classic battle of the sexes where the tension is high but the mood stays light and breezy.

What really makes this work is the fast pacing and the physical comedy that keeps you smiling. While the acting is a bit over-the-top since it is a silent film, it adds to the charm. You might find some parts a bit dated, but the mystery involving a stolen jewel adds a nice kick to the plot. If you enjoy old-school rom-coms, you should definitely track this down. Since it is an older gem, try finding a restored version to stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or grab a 4K Blu-ray to keep in your physical collection for the best quality.
endingExplained: Things get wild when Pat and Scoop both get kidnapped by a thief named Clayton. He stole a jewel from a maharajah and takes them onto his yacht to keep them quiet. However, they manage to get rescued just in time. After the danger passes, Scoop finally admits that Pat is just as talented as he is. The rivalry ends with the two of them falling in love and finding happiness together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old Hollywood charm and funny rivalries.
